text_blocks.snippet: Common and serious side effects of losartan (Cozaar) include:
snippet_highlighted_words: Common and serious side effects of losartan (Cozaar) include:

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness (especially when standing up quickly)
Headache (often temporary during the first 1 to 2 weeks)
Upper respiratory tract infections or stuffy nose
Back, joint, or muscle pain / cramps
Digestive upset (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or mild stomach pain)

text_blocks.snippet: Serious Side Effects (Seek Immediate Medical Attention)

list.snippet: Angioedema: Severe swelling of the face, lips, tongue, throat, eyes, or mouth, which can cause difficulty breathing or swallowing.
High potassium levels (Hyperkalemia): Symptoms include muscle weakness, confusion, shortness of breath, or a fast/irregular heartbeat.
Kidney problems or injury: Signs include a decrease in the amount of urine produced, blood in the urine, or sudden swelling in the legs, ankles, or feet.
Severely low blood pressure (Hypotension): Causing fainting, severe dizziness, or blurry vision.
Liver problems: Signs include yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice).
Pregnancy Warning: Losartan must not be taken during pregnancy as it can cause serious harm or death to an unborn baby.

Medication Interactions: Use caution or avoid combining losartan with potassium supplements, salt substitutes containing potassium, ACE inhibitors, or NSAIDs (like ibuprofen or naproxen) without talking to your doctor.

text_blocks.snippet: Most mild side effects like dizziness and headaches improve over time as your body adjusts to the medication.
